cylinders.name: cylinders
cylinders.meaning: The number of cylinders in the car's engine.

edispl.name: edispl
edispl.meaning: Engine displacement, typically measured in cubic inches.

horsepower.name: horsepower
horsepower.meaning: The power output of the car's engine.

weight.name: weight
weight.meaning: The weight of the car, likely in pounds.

accelerate.name: accelerate
accelerate.meaning: Time taken to accelerate from 0 to 60 mph, in seconds.

year.name: year
year.meaning: The model year of the car.

table.name: d_customer_complaints__products
table.summary: A catalog of products containing identification details, categorization, availability dates, descriptions, and pricing.

product_id.name: product_id
product_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each product record.

parent_product_id.name: parent_product_id
parent_product_id.meaning: Reference to the parent product, indicating a hierarchical relationship (e.g., product variants or sub-categories).

product_category_code.name: product_category_code
product_category_code.meaning: Alphanumeric code representing the broad category of the product.

date_product_first_available.name: date_product_first_available
date_product_first_available.meaning: The timestamp when the product was first released or became available for sale.

date_product_discontinued.name: date_product_discontinued
date_product_discontinued.meaning: The timestamp when the product was removed from sale or discontinued.

product_name.name: product_name
product_name.meaning: The human-readable name of the product.

product_description.name: product_description
product_description.meaning: A detailed textual description of the product's features or purpose.

product_price.name: product_price
product_price.meaning: The monetary value assigned to the product.

college_id.name: college_id
college_id.meaning: A unique short code identifier for each college.

name_full.name: name_full
name_full.meaning: The complete official name of the college or university.

city.name: city
city.meaning: The city where the college is located.

state.name: state

country.name: country
